title: A Pre-Norm Transformer Block by Hand
learning_objectives: Implement layer normalisation over the feature axis
Assemble attention and feed-forward sub-layers with residual connections
Verify causality: earlier outputs do not depend on later tokens
entry_point: layer_norm(x, gamma, beta, eps=1e-5); feed_forward(x, W1, b1, W2, b2); transformer_block(x, params, h)
hints: `mu = x.mean(axis=-1, keepdims=True)`, `var = x.var(axis=-1, keepdims=True)`, then `gamma * (x - mu) / np.sqrt(var + eps) + beta`.
`a = layer_norm(x, p["ln1_g"], p["ln1_b"])`; `h1 = x + multi_head_attention(a, p["Wq"], ..., h, causal=True)`; then the same pattern with LN2 and the FFN.

failure_feedback.advice: Normalise along the last axis with the population variance (`x.var(axis=-1)`).
Apply ReLU between the two linear maps.
Add each sub-layer's output to its input (residual connections).
Pre-norm: normalise *before* each sub-layer and use causal attention.
Pass `causal=True` to the attention so later tokens cannot affect earlier outputs.
